title: Generate native Seedance sequences up to 30 seconds in CapCut PC.
content:
Generate native Seedance sequences up to 30 seconds in CapCut PC.  
Use reference media plus timestamped instructions to guide the subject, movement, and story structure during generation.  
Use CapCut PC’s AI Edit to adjust local elements without restarting the entire generation.  
Use CapCut PC’s AI Extend to continue action forward or backward when you need to lengthen a moment.  
Finish by assembling the final story on CapCut PC’s multi-track timeline and add captions, music, effects, transitions, and pacing.

ある瞬間にもっと時間が必要なときは、CapCut PCのAI Extendでアクションを前方または後方へ継続し、ストーリーに余白を持たせることができます。

最終的なストーリーはタイムライン上で完成します。
